name: Ghana Senior High School - SHS 1 to SHS 3 (WASSCE)

sources.title: WASSCE for school candidates: the four core subjects, the programmes and options with their electives, three or four electives
National Pre-tertiary Education Curriculum Framework (2019): section 8 on assessment, Table 5 (SHS bands A to G and U), CA 30 percent
Subject Combination Guidelines for Secondary Education: 7 to 9 subjects externally assessed (the NaCCA page summary was read, not the PDF)

verification.notes: Draft, not reviewed by a NaCCA, GES or WAEC Ghana officer. Firm (read 2026-10-27): the four WASSCE core subjects, the six programmes and a selection of their electives, three or four electives per candidate, NaCCA's SHS letter bands (Table 5) and its 30 percent continuous assessment. Open items, all listed in the README: (1) no percentage range for the WASSCE grades A1 to F9 was found, so none is modelled; the grades are entered results. (2) The elective list is a selection, not the full set. (3) A credit being A1 to C6 is the common reading and is not stated in a fetched Ghanaian document; the admission aggregate is not modelled. (4) The framework's SHS core subjects differ from the four WAEC cores; WAEC is followed for the examination. (5) Nothing fetched states how many CA marks WAEC receives; the framework's 30 percent is used and is overridable. (6) Promotion is a class-council suggestion at an annual average of 40; no national rule was found. (7) The Akan (Twi) labels are a draft translation that no native speaker has reviewed.
